description: This course focuses on fundamental knowledge for nursing practice. Students examine core concepts of physiological integrity, adaptation, and the delivery of basic care and comfort. Learners engage in classroom instruction with hands-on clinical rotations, simulation, and laboratory experiences. By the end of this course, learners are able to demonstrate competency in basic nursing skills while progressing towards competency in performing holistic patient assessments. Prerequisites: Open to junior nursing majors only; NURS 211 and NURS 212 with grades of C or above; concurrent enrollment in NURS 310.
